title: Global all-M supports and the sharp isotropic rank-one coefficient family
statement: For every real2x2 M, P=F+z^T M nu(w)+lambda(r+t) is polyconvex when lambda>=||M||_F^2/8, by the explicit global minor-support selector lambda_A=lambda-|z|^2-2|w|^2 and its proved support inequality. For rank M<=1 this equals the exact ROC threshold, hence ROC=QC=PC for these isotropic tails including equality/determinant lineality. Adding a ROC quadratic residual gives the corresponding full-Q sufficient QC class; it does not classify every admitted fullQ. The full-rank conformal family is non-PC for lambda=3/16+d,0<=d<(43-3sqrt(205))/288, without a QC conclusion in that gap.
